prompt:
Edit the attached EMPTY jar layer by creating ONLY an interior dusk scene insert for it. Same 1024-equivalent square canvas, same placement/scale. The summer-evening interior fades from pale glass blue near rim y=330–440 into rich ink blue #2F5D8A at y=550 and deep navy #16263F at the bottom y=860. Interior follows the jar body x=250–780, rounded shoulders and rounded bottom; everything outside fully transparent. Add exactly FIVE slender dark navy grass blades, gently curving upward from the jar bottom y=855, varied heights to y=720–805, clustered irregularly without symmetry. Minimal hand-inked style. NO fireflies, NO gold glow, NO lid, NO string. Output the interior gradient and grass only, no jar outline or white highlights; these will be composited behind the existing unchanged glass outline, rim and highlights as part of the STATIC JAR LAYER. Smooth subtle gradient, no hard horizon edge. Match the attached style sheet exactly. original design, no logos, no brand names or brand shapes, no characters, no text.

App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
